23. What happens to a method's parameters after the method finishes execution?
Parameters are local variables of the method.
When the method finishes and its activation record is removed, the memory allocated for those parameters is also removed.
For example, the parameters of a setter exist only while that setter is executing.
24. When does an object become eligible for garbage collection?
An object can become eligible for garbage collection when no reference variable is referring to it.
For example, when the reference that was pointing to an object is no longer available, the object can become unreachable and eligible for garbage collection.
